email_body:
Dear YEU Team,

I am writing to apply for the Project and Communication Assistant role at YEU International. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your mission of empowering young people through non-formal education.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have supported project implementation, managed CMS content, and created engaging social media and newsletter content. My experience organising international meetings and events comes from my time at Knowledge Experts, where I helped build digital workplace sites for large clients. I am proactive, creative, and thrive in multicultural environments, having worked remotely with teams across Europe and Turkey.

I am ready to live in Brussels and have the legal right to work in Belgium. I am committed to the full 12-month traineeship and excited about the opportunity to support YEU's communication and project activities.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear YEU Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Project and Communication Assistant position at YEU International. Your commitment to youth work and non-formal education resonates deeply with me, and I am eager to bring my skills in digital communication, project support, and content creation to your Secretariat in Brussels.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in project implementation, administrative support, and content management. I have managed CMS platforms like WordPress, created engaging social media content, and drafted reports using analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console. My work on international projects, including building websites for clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, has honed my organisational and IT skills, and taught me to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.

I have a strong understanding of non-formal education through my involvement in youth-focused projects, such as building a website for a Belgian youth chess champion. This experience taught me the importance of clear communication and creative content in engaging young audiences. I am proactive, flexible, and team-oriented, and I thrive in multicultural environments—having worked remotely with colleagues across Turkey and Europe.

I am ready to live in Brussels and have the legal right to work in Belgium. I am fully committed to the 12-month traineeship and excited about the opportunity to support YEU's mission. I am confident that my blend of technical and communication skills will allow me to contribute effectively to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support YEU's work.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Supported project implementation and administrative tasks in digital marketing roles, managing CMS content and client communications.
• Organised and contributed to international projects, including building digital workplace sites for large clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo.
• Created engaging social media content and newsletters, using tools like Canva and WordPress to drive audience engagement.
• Strong IT skills with proficiency in WordPress, HTML/CSS, and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console).
• Proven ability to work in multicultural environments, with remote collaboration experience across Turkey and Europe.
